section.title: Document Content
section.p: This document provides instructions for installing, commissioning, and configuring the controller, a device used in building automation systems. It covers initial setup (including microSD card handling, network configuration, and licensing), running the Commissioning Wizard to load drivers and set up security, and managing platform services. It also explains how to troubleshoot common issues, reset credentials, restore factory defaults, and use the system shell for low-level configuration. The document provides security best practices, such as changing default credentials and safeguarding passphrases.
This guide is intended for developers, systems engineers, and facility managers.
